# Lab 3.6: Pub/Sub BigQuery Subscription

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a Pub/Sub topic with a schema and a BigQuery subscription that writes messages straight into a table, with no code.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create the target table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab03.orders_stream (
  order_id STRING,
  amount FLOAT64,
  city STRING
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Create a schema and a topic.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable pubsub.googleapis.com
cat &gt; order.avsc &lt;&lt;'EOF'
{"type": "record", "name": "Order", "fields": [
  {"name": "order_id", "type": "string"},
  {"name": "amount", "type": "double"},
  {"name": "city", "type": "string"}]}
EOF
gcloud pubsub schemas create order-schema --type=AVRO --definition-file=order.avsc
gcloud pubsub topics create orders-topic --schema=order-schema --message-encoding=JSON</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Let Pub/Sub write to BigQuery.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">PROJECT_NUMBER=$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)")
PUBSUB_SA=service-$PROJECT_NUMBER@gcp-sa-pubsub.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:$PUBSUB_SA --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Create the BigQuery subscription.** Go to **Pub/Sub → Subscriptions → Create subscription**:
   - **ID**: `orders-to-bq`
   - **Topic**: `orders-topic`
   - **Delivery type**: Write to BigQuery
   - **Table**: `lab03.orders_stream`
   - **Schema configuration**: Use topic schema

   The same subscription from the CLI:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub subscriptions create orders-to-bq --topic=orders-topic \
  --bigquery-table=$PROJECT_ID:lab03.orders_stream --use-topic-schema</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Publish messages.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">for i in 1 2 3; do
  gcloud pubsub topics publish orders-topic --message="{\"order_id\":\"o-$i\",\"amount\":$((i*100)).5,\"city\":\"Surat\"}"
done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **[SQL] Query the table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM lab03.orders_stream;</span>
</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Topic | Validates messages against the Avro schema |
| Subscription | Writes to BigQuery directly |
| Code | None needed |
| Rows | 3 orders in `orders_stream` within seconds |
